product.description: EcoFresh Organic Quinoa 500g delivers a premium, sustainably sourced grain that supports a balanced diet. Harvested from high‑altitude Andean farms, the quinoa is certified organic and free from GMOs, providing a rich source of plant‑based protein, fiber, and essential minerals. The 500‑gram pouch features a resealable zipper for long‑term freshness and is packaged in recyclable materials to minimize environmental impact. Ideal for salads, pilafs, or as a hearty side, this quinoa offers a nutty flavor and fluffy texture when cooked. With a shelf life of up to 18 months under cool, dry storage, it is a convenient pantry staple for health‑conscious consumers.
